stage0042_03:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$シャア$$
「...Well then, Mr. President...
　Now that the wartime law agreement is settled,
　you and your aides will be released」

stage0042_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$大統領$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$... there's still time now.
　Won't you reconsider?」

stage0042_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$シャア$$
「If my resolve were light enough to waver now,
　I'd never have taken up my father's mantle」

stage0042_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$シーリン$$
「We gave you every bit of data $c gathered
　on whoever it is that wants this war.
　Even so?」

stage0042_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$クラウス$$
「With invaders from other dimensions and
　worlds appearing, you must understand
　humanity has no room to fight itself」

stage0042_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$シャア$$
「That was merely a hint of what's to come...」

stage0042_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's exactly why.
　That's exactly why I believe humanity
　must change」

stage0042_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$カイザス$$
「Now all the preparations are in place」

stage0042_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$シャア$$
「Seizing the President the moment we
　declared war was underhanded, I'll admit」

stage0042_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$カイザス$$
「Is that the guilt that brought you
　down to Earth in person?」

stage0042_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$シャア$$
「...Perhaps.
　Even I think that's naive of me」

stage0042_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$カイザス$$
「With Earth supremacists growing in strength,
　a meeting between the President and Supreme
　Commander could never happen through normal means」

stage0042_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$カイザス$$
「Had it come to that, lawlessness would reign,
　and we'd even have ended up allowing
　indiscriminate attacks on colonies」

stage0042_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$カイザス$$
「I believe it's precisely because the President
　understood that, that he approved the treaty,
　starting with the ban on attacking habitats」

stage0042_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$シャア$$
「Our first goal is toppling the Earth supremacists.
　There's no need to drag civilians into this war」

stage0042_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$カイザス$$
「No...
　Given the aftermath, I'd call it a wise choice」

stage0042_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$カイザス$$
「In fact, with you rising up, Supreme Commander,
　support for Neo Zeon among the colonies,
　including $$プラント$$, has become decisive」

stage0042_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$カイザス$$
「We also have $$アクシズ$$ on our side.
　We won't fall behind the Federation in resources」

stage0042_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$シャア$$
「But now that we're evenly matched in strength,
　this becomes all-out war with the Federation」

stage0042_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$カイザス$$
「The next task will be winning this war
　as quickly as possible」

stage0042_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$シャア$$
「...I'm going out for a while」

stage0042_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$カイザス$$
「Understood.
　I'll arrange an escort on this end」

stage0042_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$シャア$$
（$$アムロ$$... I won't stop now.
　If you're nearby, try to feel my presence）

stage0042_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$!
　Is the Unicorn still not tuned!」

stage0042_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Hurry it up...!
　Now that they've declared war, Neo Zeon
　will hit us bolder than ever before!」

stage0042_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「This $c will be their target too,
　and the Red Comet might show up again...!
　When that happens, the Unicorn goes out too!」

stage0042_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$バナージ$$
「But, Mr. $$アルベルト$$...
　From what $$カミーユ$$ said, the red machine that appeared
　after Industrial 7 wasn't $$シャア・アズナブル$$'s...」

stage0042_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Then who was piloting the $$シナンジュ$$!?
　It came at three times the speed in that red machine!」

stage0042_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Don't ask me,
　how would I know that...」

stage0042_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$アスカ$$
「What's with that guy over there...
　throwing his hissy fit like that」

stage0042_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Guys who only push their own wants
　like that just annoy me to watch」

stage0042_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$カレン$$
「Looks like you and $$シンジ$$ hit it off, $$アスカ$$」

stage0042_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Pretty familiar, aren't you...
　While aboard $c, it's Captain Shikinami」

stage0042_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Even you don't call $$ミサト$$ 'Colonel
　Katsuragi' either, Shikinami...!」

stage0042_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$カレン$$
「$$シンジ$$'s got a point」

stage0042_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$カレン$$
「Besides, if we're going there,
　as your senior in the Volunteer Club,
　you'd better call me Senior Kozuki」

stage0042_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Didn't Mr. $$扇$$ tell you?
　Students on $c are supposed to
　work as the Volunteer Club in $$第２新東京市$$...」

stage0042_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$カレン$$
「We left in such a rush,
　I didn't even get to say bye to $$かなめ$$,
　but I'll put her through the wringer when I'm back」

stage0042_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$カレン$$
「No need to be modest.
　Looking after juniors is a senior's duty,
　and Mr. $$扇$$ asked me to look after $$アスカ$$ too」

stage0042_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$アスカ$$
「None of your business.
　That goes for that frizzy-haired teacher, and you」

stage0042_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Honestly, $$カレン$$...
　I don't like you, you know」

stage0042_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$アスカ$$
「That KMF of yours,
　it's called the Guren Mk-II, right?」

stage0042_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$カレン$$
「Y-Yeah...
　though it's been refit to the S.E.I.T.E.N. now」

stage0042_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Being 'red' and a '2'
　overlaps with my Unit-02!」

stage0042_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$カレン$$
「I've had someone give me grief before,
　over that same name Guren too」

stage0042_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Who said something like that to you?」

stage0042_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$カレン$$
「...A guy who was an important comrade.
　Our first meeting was the worst too,
　but we got close pretty fast...」

stage0042_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Thinking you can win me over easily is a big mistake」

stage0042_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$カレン$$
「'Win you over,' such a fancy word to use...
　You're so cute, $$アスカ$$」

stage0042_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$甲児$$
「That $$カレン$$...
　sure is fussing over $$アスカ$$ a lot」

stage0042_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$n
「Not just because middle school Mr. $$扇$$ asked」

stage0042_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$アルト$$
「Sounds like you know what's going on, $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$」

stage0042_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「$$カレン$$ likes playing big sister.
　Both to $$シンジ$$ and to that woman」

stage0042_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「After all, she was the youngest in the Black
　Knights, treated like everyone's little sister」

stage0042_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$シン$$
「Heh... she's got a cute side too, $$カレン$$」

stage0042_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$n
「Yeah.
　I think a bit better of her now」

stage0042_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$カレン$$
「I can hear you, $$シン$$ and $n!
　Especially you, $n!
　You want me to tattle to Miss $$スズネ$$ that bad!?」

stage0042_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$アルト$$
「Give it up, $n.
　Seems like that's just your role」

stage0042_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$シン$$
「Thanks to that, I'm off the hook.
　I owe you one, $n」

stage0042_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「So, this ship left Japan,
　where's it headed?」

stage0042_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$カレン$$
「You... weren't listening to the briefing again?」

stage0042_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Don't say that.
　Come on, tell me, big sister $$カレン$$」

stage0042_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$カレン$$
「That's a weird way to put it...!」

stage0042_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$アルト$$
「$c is heading to North America
　to link up with the $$ラー・カイラム$$」

stage0042_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$シン$$
「Londo Bell's flagship.
　Captain $$ブライト・ノア$$, her skipper, is also
　Londo Bell's commander」

stage0042_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$甲児$$
「In $$ＵＣＷ$$, $$カミーユ$$ and Captain $$アムロ$$
　fought under that person's command」

stage0042_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$n
「Since they've got things to discuss with him,
　the Captain, $$カミーユ$$, and $$カツ$$ went ahead of us」

stage0042_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Got it, loud and clear.
　Thanks, boys」

stage0042_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$シン$$
「Being called that once in a while isn't so bad」

stage0042_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$n
「Nah... just a bit worried about $$カミーユ$$」

stage0042_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$アルト$$
「Now that you mention it, he's been
　kind of down ever since Neo Zeon
　declared war」

stage0042_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$甲児$$
「Guess he's bothered that Captain $$クワトロ$$
　started a new war after all」

stage0042_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$シン$$
「...This is something $$カミーユ$$ has
　to work out on his own.
　It's not for the rest of us to fuss over...」

stage0042_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$シン$$
（Captain $$アムロ$$ took him out to clear his head,
　hope it actually helps him unwind...）

stage0042_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Mr. $$カツ$$, Mr. $$アムロ$$!」

stage0042_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$カツ$$
「$$ハサウェイ$$...!
　You came down to Earth too?」

stage0042_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$クェス$$
「By the way, I'm here too」

stage0042_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$クェス・パラヤ$$...
　Why are you here?」

stage0042_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$アストナージ$$
「Her father, Vice Minister $$アデナウアー$$,
　went home ages ago, but this girl
　just settled right into the $$ラー・カイラム$$」

stage0042_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$アストナージ$$
「This ship's job was mainly gathering intel
　in the rear, so we allowed her aboard
　with $$ハサウェイ$$, on the condition it's until Earth」

stage0042_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$アムロ$$
「It's been a while, $$アストナージ$$」

stage0042_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$アストナージ$$
「Good timing.
　Someone who wants to meet you, Captain,
　just reported aboard the $$ラー・カイラム$$」

stage0042_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$チェーン$$
「A pleasure, Captain.
　I'm technical officer $$チェーン・アギ$$」

stage0042_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$アムロ・レイ$$.
　Pleased to meet you」

stage0042_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$チェーン$$
「Meeting you confirms it.
　White really does suit you, Captain」

stage0042_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$チェーン$$
「Actually, I was once on loan to Anaheim,
　where I helped develop the $$νガンダム$$」

stage0042_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$チェーン$$
「So when we sent the $$νガンダム$$ to $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$
　during the $$多元戦争$$, I took it on myself
　to send a white normal suit to you too」

stage0042_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$アムロ$$
「So that was you back then...」

stage0042_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$チェーン$$
「You look more grown-up than in your old photos.
　I think the white suit fits you even better now」

stage0042_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$アストナージ$$
「Quite popular, Captain.
　You didn't earn the ace title for nothing」

stage0042_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$チェーン$$
「Wha... why, I'm this ship's mechanic...」

stage0042_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$クェス$$
「Spoken like an adult.
　That's not what I'm asking.
　I mean your relationship with $$アムロ・レイ$$!」

stage0042_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$チェーン$$
「Relationship... he's a man I admire」

stage0042_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$クェス$$
「That's not it!
　I trained in India so that everyone
　could become Newtypes who understand each other」

stage0042_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$クェス$$
「That's why I was interested in $$アムロ$$,
　the so-called Newtype, so why get in my way!?」

stage0042_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$クェス$$
「To me, that's exactly what you are.
　Get off this ship!」

stage0042_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$チェーン$$
「There's no way I can do that」

stage0042_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Sorry, $$チェーン$$.
　Let's talk properly later」

stage0042_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Cheer up, $$クェス$$.
　Besides, that was rude to $$チェーン$$」

stage0042_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「When we get back, let's apologize
　to $$チェーン$$. I'll come with you」

stage0042_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$クェス$$
「Stop talking about that already!
　$$アムロ$$ brought me here to cheer up,
　I don't want to hear a lecture!」

stage0042_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$カツ$$
「Rough on $$ハサウェイ$$.
　Sounds like $$クェス$$ has had him
　wrapped around her finger」

stage0042_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Managed to clear your head a bit, $$カミーユ$$?」

stage0042_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$シン$$ and the others were worried.
　Said you've been acting strange...」

stage0042_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「...Somewhere inside, I thought I was
　ready for the day Captain $$クワトロ$$
　would call himself $$シャア・アズナブル$$ again...」

stage0042_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「But, to think... he'd start a war...」

stage0042_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Accept reality.
　He chose a different path than us」

stage0042_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Then, Captain $$アムロ$$, if Captain
　$$クワトロ$$... if $$シャア$$ showed up
　in front of you...」

stage0042_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I'll shoot him.
　He has that same resolve,
　that's why he calls himself $$シャア$$」

stage0042_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$クェス$$
「$$カミーユ$$... you seem down」

stage0042_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Sounds like both $$アムロ$$ and $$カミーユ$$
　are troubled about $$シャア$$」

stage0042_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$クェス$$
「Kind of a letdown...
　I thought $$カミーユ$$ was a stronger man」

stage0042_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$クェス$$
「In that regard, $$アムロ$$'s amazing.
　Guess it's 'cause he's an adult Newtype」

stage0042_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Not worrying doesn't mean you're strong.
　Sometimes it's the opposite」

stage0042_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I wouldn't know.
　I've never thought of myself that way」

stage0042_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$クェス$$
「I thought $$アムロ$$ was more amazing
　than this... Falling for a woman
　like that, I guess...」

stage0042_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$シャア$$
「Meeting you in a place like this.
　Quite the coincidence...」

stage0042_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$アムロ$$
「What are you trying to do!?
　Are you going to waste what we
　fought for with $$トレーズ$$ and $$ルルーシュ$$!」

stage0042_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$シャア$$
「Unlike you, I can't afford to be
　just a pilot!」

stage0042_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Why would a man who fought beside
　us start another war!?」

stage0042_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Do you understand!?
　What you're doing is on a different
　scale from $$エゥーゴ$$'s fight with $$ティターンズ$$!」

stage0042_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Even if it doesn't drag people
　into the fighting directly, this
　war will gather so much grief!」

stage0042_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$シャア$$
「But unless mankind advances to a
　higher stage, the history of war
　will repeat itself!」

stage0042_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$クェス$$
（But I understand...
　what $$シャア$$'s saying...）

stage0042_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$シャア$$
「Don't you see, $$アムロ$$!
　Unless the rot is purged completely,
　people and the world will never change!」

stage0042_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$シャア$$
「Human ego will destroy the world!」

stage0042_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Human wisdom can overcome
　even that!」

stage0042_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$シャア$$
「Then show me you can grant wisdom
　to every fool alive, right now!」

stage0042_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$シャア$$
「If you can't, mankind is finished!」

stage0042_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$クェス$$
「That's right!
　Because he can't, $$シャア$$...」

stage0042_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$シャア$$!
　Right here, I'll...」

stage0042_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$シャア$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$, is it...
　Firing without warning is uncouth」

stage0042_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Everything I do is out of concern
　for you, Commander」

stage0042_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「This feeling... the man who rode
　the $$シナンジュ$$!」

stage0042_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$シャア$$
「We're falling back.
　Any further and this gets troublesome」

stage0042_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Stop, both of you!
　There's no point chasing them!」

stage0042_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$カツ$$
「$$アムロ$$...!
　We've got a transmission from the $$ラー・カイラム$$!」

stage0042_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$カツ$$
「Neo Zeon forces that entered the
　atmosphere are heading for Minot Base!」

stage0042_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Minot...!
　Their target's the nuclear missiles!」

stage0042_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ブライト$$
「What about that $$シナンジュ$$ pilot?」

stage0042_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$アムロ$$
「It wasn't $$シャア$$, someone else.
　But...」

stage0042_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$シャア$$ called him $$フル・フロンタル$$,
　but his face and voice were just
　like $$シャア$$'s」

stage0042_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$ブライト$$
「A body double... is that it?」

stage0042_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$アムロ$$
（But it's not just a passing
　resemblance...
　What's his tie to $$シャア$$...）

stage0042_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Commander $$レディ・アン$$ just got in touch.
　The $$大統領$$ and his aides, held by
　Neo Zeon, were rescued in New York」

stage0042_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$ブライト$$
「$$シャア$$ probably came down to Earth
　to free the $$大統領$$」

stage0042_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$アムロ$$
「But why choose a spot
　so close to where the $$ラー・カイラム$$
　was going to dock?」

stage0042_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$ブライト$$
「...I don't want to think it, but...」

stage0042_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Is he saying that's his idea of
　courtesy to a former comrade...」

stage0042_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$ブライト$$
「He's shut in his room, in shock.
　His girlfriend was taken right
　in front of him」

stage0042_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$ブライト$$
「I'll have to leave $$ハサウェイ$$ to Mirai.
　Now that the $$ラー・カイラム$$'s going into
　combat, we can't keep him aboard」

stage0042_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...That wasn't a kidnapping.
　$$クェス$$ chose to go with $$シャア$$ herself」

stage0042_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$ブライト$$
「I can't bring myself to tell
　Deputy Chief $$アデナウアー$$.
　Not that he cares about her anymore」

stage0042_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...Maybe $$クェス$$ was looking for
　a father figure in $$シャア$$...」

stage0042_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$ブライト$$
「A father figure, from that man...
　If so, he's grown up more than the
　Captain $$クワトロ$$ we used to know」

stage0042_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Things don't look good.
　We need to build up our own strength
　to counter that $$シナンジュ$$」

stage0042_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Zeta and the $$νガンダム$$...
　I'll see what I can arrange」

stage0042_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$アムロ$$
「If $$シャア$$'s conscious of me...
　of us, he'll show up on the
　battlefield eventually」

stage0042_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...If that's what he wants,
　I'll settle it」

stage0042_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$アムロ$$
（Even if it means making $$ララァ$$
　sad...）

stage0042_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$ブライト$$
「So it's the core, and Unicorn as well, huh...」

stage0042_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「There are other problems besides that」

stage0042_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$ブライト$$
「$$カミーユ$$, is it...
　Can I leave it to him?」

stage0042_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I'll give it a shot.
　If we're up against $$シャア$$, I'll need
　to play my part too, I suppose」

stage0042_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$アマタ$$
「So that guy, $$シャア・アズナブル$$,
　used to fight alongside you all before...」

stage0042_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$葵$$
「Back then, his name was $$クワトロ・バジーナ$$, though」

stage0042_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「To explain in more detail,
　his real name is Casval Rem Deikun...」

stage0042_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「He's said to be the orphaned child of
　Zeon Zum Deikun, who laid the groundwork
　for the Republic of Zeon, Neo Zeon's precursor」

stage0042_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Zeon Zum Deikun was assassinated.
　The Republic of Zeon then became the
　Principality, under Zabi family dictatorship」

stage0042_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$朔哉$$
「So that assassination... Zabi was behind it...」

stage0042_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Casval Rem Deikun came to the same
　conclusion as $$朔哉$$ and the public: to
　overthrow the Zabi family, his father's killers...」

stage0042_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Under the false name $$シャア・アズナブル$$,
　he enlisted with the Zeon military」

stage0042_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$カイエン$$
「So he chose to strike the top from within...」

stage0042_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「$$シャア$$, having become a Zeon ace, fought
　a desperate duel with Captain $$アムロ$$,
　an ace of the Earth Federation Forces」

stage0042_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「And, after many twists and turns,
　$$シャア$$ succeeded in overthrowing the Zabi family」

stage0042_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「The charisma of $$シャア$$, Zeon's Red Comet,
　became legend, and combined with his
　bloodline, won him support as the next leader」

stage0042_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「That's the story of $$シャア・アズナブル$$ I read
　in 'Monthly: A Man's Red Comet'」

stage0042_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$くらら$$
「So after being 《$$エゥーゴ$$》's $$クワトロ・バジーナ$$,
　he rose to lead Neo Zeon as its commander...」

stage0042_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$アンディ$$
「But hey, to everyone who fought
　alongside him, that's basically betrayal」

stage0042_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「Both $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$
　have fought those who resort to war, after all」

stage0042_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「So how about Team D?
　Is it more like, '$$シャア$$ must pay'...?」

stage0042_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$くらら$$
「War as an act aside,
　when it comes to $$シャア・アズナブル$$ himself,
　there's not much anger or hatred」

stage0042_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Team D's surprisingly cool about this...」

stage0042_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Really...
　Hard to believe how fired up they get in battle...」

stage0042_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Maybe.
　Might not be what you're expecting, but
　we're not hot-blooded all year round」

stage0042_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Still, I intend to brush off any sparks
　that fall on us. If $$シャア・アズナブル$$
　makes us his target, we'll fight full-force」

stage0042_03:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$カイエン$$
「...Just like a beast.
　Lazes about when its belly's full,
　bares its fangs when danger's near...」

stage0042_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$葵$$
（But, what's this... this frustration...
　There used to be times my heart burned hotter...）

stage0042_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$くらら$$
「We can shrug it off like that, but
　I wonder how it is for them...」

stage0042_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...You know what I mean, don't you, $$カミーユ$$?」

stage0042_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I know that already...!
　It's my fault $$バナージ$$ was taken...」

stage0042_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$シン$$
「I'll say it straight...!
　You're scared of Captain $$クワトロ$$'s shadow!」

stage0042_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$シン$$
「You're just like I used to be, letting
　Chairman 《$$デュランダル$$》 decide what's right!」

stage0042_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$シン$$
「You said this to me back then, $$カミーユ$$...」

stage0042_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$シン$$
「'You've stopped judging for yourself and are
　just drunk on someone else's idea of right...!'」

stage0042_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$シン$$
「So how can you, of all people, be scared of
　Captain $$クワトロ$$'s shadow and lose sight of
　what you need to do!?」

stage0042_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$シン$$
「Captain $$クワトロ$$ has nothing to do with it...!
　Fight with your own will!」

stage0042_03:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$シン$$
「Then you get it, right?
　What you need to do right now.」

stage0042_03:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$シン$$
「...Sorry, Captain $$アムロ$$.
　I kind of ended up butting in...」

stage0042_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$アムロ$$
「It's fine, $$シン$$.
　Coming from you, it'll probably
　hit home for $$カミーユ$$ more anyway.」

stage0042_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$アムロ$$
「If you understand, I've got nothing more to say.
　So...」

stage0042_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Yes, sir...
　I'll save $$バナージ$$ with my own hands, no matter what.」

stage0042_03:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$エマ$$
「The stolen core is a problem, but
　Unicorn's capture is baffling too」

stage0042_03:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$リディ$$
「Now that I think of it, Neo Zeon seemed
　to be after that unit since Industrial 7」

stage0042_03:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$エマ$$
「Besides being a new model, I wonder
　if that Gundam's really worth moving
　a whole unit for...」

stage0042_03:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's all the more reason we need
　to rescue $$バナージ$$ to find out」

stage0042_03:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$リディ$$
「But what do we do...?
　We don't even have a clue where he was taken.」

stage0042_03:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Lt. Colonel $$ダグザ$$, where is $$バナージ$$...!?」

stage0042_03:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Where the Neo Zeon unit that took him is headed...
　Probably Palau.」

stage0042_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「A mineral resource satellite near Side 6.
　It's a Neo Zeon stronghold now.」

stage0042_03:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Before they carry the core to $$アクシズ$$,
　they should stop there first」

stage0042_03:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$リディ$$
「Guess we're heading back to space again...」

stage0042_03:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（Wait for me, $$バナージ$$...
　I will come save you, no matter what...）

stage0042_03:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You seem down.
　It's $$バナージ$$ you're worried about, isn't it」

stage0042_03:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It'll be fine, Master $$オードリー$$.
　Master $$カミーユ$$'s gotten over $$シャア・アズナブル$$ too,
　so $$バナージ$$ will surely be rescued」

stage0042_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$オードリー$$, you know $c's
　hidden strength too, don't you?」

stage0042_03:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$...
　You're trying to cheer me up, aren't you」

stage0042_03:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$オードリー$$
「I feel a little lighter now.
　I want to believe in $c
　just as you do」

stage0042_03:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's right, Master $$オードリー$$!
　I'm glad to be of help too!」

stage0042_03:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Well then, I have duties with the
　chores crew, so I'll excuse myself」

stage0042_03:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「When that mobile suit, the $$シナンジュ$$,
　was shot down, Master $$オードリー$$'s heart
　stirred, and a Z-Chip was born」

stage0042_03:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That amount, 100 Z...
　I'll add this to the squad's stock」

stage0042_03:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I did want to ask Master $$オードリー$$
　about her connection to that unit, but I
　can hardly ask right now, can I...」

stage0042_03:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$オードリー$$ needs watching from now on...
　I'll have to try all sorts of things...」

stage0042_03:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I must try this, and I must try that too...」

stage0042_03:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Looks like you've moved past it, Master $$カミーユ$$」

stage0042_03:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I... was worried, you know.
　If Master $$カミーユ$$ stayed all sour like that,
　you'd surely go barreling down misery road」

stage0042_03:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The girl who won your heart dies protecting you,
　and in the thick of battle your reliable senior,
　cocky junior, and beloved big sister all die too...」

stage0042_03:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And then, imagining you'd finally end up
　ranting hotly about comets and all that,
　it makes me so sad, so very sad...」

stage0042_03:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「What in the world are you even talking about...」

stage0042_03:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's just a figure of speech for how
　worried I was. Please don't mind it」

stage0042_03:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But well... now that you've bounced back,
　I'd like to see proof of it」

stage0042_03:r_4cab8ba7b88b6c2a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let's give it our all today too!」

stage0042_03:r_20aab898d4d14e51.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「...This is what you wanted, right?」

stage0042_03:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Much obliged!
　Now I can rest easy too!」
